stem: Which sentence best explains why Charlie Joe's father considers sending Charlie Joe to Camp Rituhbukkee?

options.label: A
options.text: Finally my dad turned around and looked at my mom, who nodded.

options.label: B
options.text: "You've never gotten straight A's in your life."

options.label: C
options.text: "It would be bad parenting if we just sat here while you threw your talents away."

options.label: D
options.text: My dad thumbed through the brochure.
